title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Tuesday, 29 September 2026
description: Today's stories: Trump and House Speaker Johnson meeting tech CEOs at the White House on AI policy, this afternoon's widely expected RBA rate hike to 4.6% on National Police Remembrance Day, the IOC's approval of Rockhampton's Fitzroy River as a 2032 Olympic rowing venue, and the Gold Coast Titans' NRLW semi-final loss ahead of Ali Brigginshaw's retirement finale. 오늘의 브리핑은 영어에 이어 한국어로도 제공됩니다.
